scenarios.name: Switch tabs while temporary commands are open in tabs-only mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is in tabs-only display with View active
the temporary View command groups are open
the user clicks the Tools tab
the temporary Tools command groups replace the View command groups
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary Tools command groups close
Tools remains the active tab in tabs-only display
